description: This file defines the DeviceAttributes class, which manages device attribute data categorized into client-side, server-private, and server-public attributes, providing methods for access, modification, and removal.

classes.name: DeviceAttributes
classes.description: Manages device attributes segregated into different scopes with methods for retrieval, update, and removal.

methods.name: DeviceAttributes
methods.description: Constructor initializing attribute maps from provided lists.

methods.name: mapAttributes
methods.description: Converts a list of AttributeKvEntry objects into a map keyed by attribute key.

methods.name: getClientSideAttribute
methods.description: Retrieves a specific client-side attribute by name.

methods.name: getServerPrivateAttribute
methods.description: Retrieves a specific server-private attribute by name.

methods.name: getServerPublicAttribute
methods.description: Retrieves a specific server-public attribute by name.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes an attribute based on its scope and key.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates attributes within a specified scope.

methods.name: getMapByScope
methods.description: Returns the attribute map corresponding to a given scope.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the DeviceAttributes object.
